copy.headline: ‘Lil Kev’ Ends Up Behind Bars In Season 2 Trailer For Kevin Hart Animated Series
copy.caption: Paramount+ has released the official trailer for Season 2 of the Kevin Hart animated series 'Lil Kev' ahead of its December 9 premiere. Lil Kev is in big trouble.

story.title: ‘Lil Kev’ Ends Up Behind Bars In Season 2 Trailer For Kevin Hart Animated Series
story.summary: Paramount+ has released the official trailer for Season 2 of the Kevin Hart animated series 'Lil Kev' ahead of its December 9 premiere. Lil Kev is in big trouble. After leading cops on a slow-speed chase, 12-year-old Kev ends up in the slammer (juvenile detentation actually) in the official trailer for Season 2 of the Kevin Hart animated series Lil Kev.
